heading: INT. ARENA - ROLLER DERBY CHAMPIONSHIP - LAST JAM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ARENA - ROLLER DERBY CHAMPIONSHIP - LAST JAM - NIGHT
A packed hall.
A banked track painted in clashing neon, chain-link fence, a scoreboard flickering.
The crowd roars in waves, a hundred foam fingers pumping.
A DJ on a scaffolding spins a bass line that shakes the railings.
At the pack: the Bay City Banshees against the Harbor Hellions.
Six skaters pivot and shove on the inside curve.
Wheels scream on the sealed concrete.
BLANCHE "BLITZKRIEG" OKONKWO, 30s, jammer for the Banshees, crouches at the line with her star-covered helmet strapped tight.
Behind her, her blocker, PRUDENCE "PRU" LINDQVIST, 40s, thick-armed, rolls on her toes.
Across the line, the Hellions' jammer, ODALYS "THE ORACLE" FERREIRA-WONG, 20s, flexes her fingers.
Her blocker, GRETA "GRAVEYARD" SZYMANSKI, 30s, spits into her mouth guard.
And the head referee, MARGUERITA "MARG" DELACROIX-NAKAMURA, 50s, in black and white stripes, raises her whistle.
Ladies and gentlemen, the final jam! Two minutes, one title!
units.name: ANNOUNCER

units.text: The whistle shrieks.
The pack erupts.
Blanche drives into the first wall, ducks Greta's hip, spins around Pru's elbow, and slips through a gap no wider than a tire.
Odalys is a half-step behind, then even, then briefly ahead.
They crash shoulder to shoulder at the first turn, and the crowd howls.
Greta slams into Pru and both skid sideways in a spray of sparks.
Marg tracks them, whistle between her teeth, arm out like a conductor.
Blanche's hip checks a Hellion, who hits the rail and slides down it.
Banshees up by two! Thirty seconds!
units.name: ANNOUNCER

units.text: Blanche glances back.
Odalys is gaining.
Her face is a mask of concentration.
Not tonight.
units.name: BLANCHE

units.text: She jumps the apex, crosses her skates in a tight loop, and rockets down the straightaway as Odalys, a breath behind, throws a hip.
Contact.
Blanche stumbles.
The crowd gasps.
Pru spins and catches her sleeve, throws her forward, a human slingshot.
Blanche glides across the line a full stride ahead.
The buzzer sounds.
The Banshees' side explodes.
Foam fingers tumble through the air.
Pru tackles Blanche from behind and they roll across the track, screaming.
Odalys coasts to the boards, helmet off, hair stuck to her forehead, and offers Blanche a hand without a word.
Blanche takes it.
They hold each other's wrists for a moment, breathing like swimmers.
Marg skates up, blows a final low whistle, and raises Blanche's arm in the air.
